title: Village Rumours
usage: Draw one whenever the party buys a round at the alehouse or gossips with the villagers. They keep what they hear, true or not.

cards.name: The Miller's Debt
cards.body: The mill owes money in town, they say, and young Tam ran off rather than work it off.

cards.name: Lights in the Chapel
cards.body: Old Hobb swears he has seen a candle moving in the chapel after midnight, twice this tenday, when nobody should be there.

cards.name: The Statue That Turned
cards.body: A girl who crept down the chapel stair on a dare swears one of the statues below turned its head to watch her go.

cards.name: The Brother's Dice
cards.body: Brother Aldous has been seen at the alehouse dice table, and he has not been winning.
